"""Worst-case scale/performance: 8192 prefixes, 131072 puts, 131072 queries, 3 saves, 16 loads."""
import json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/dev')
from harness import run, hx
import ref, repack

rng = random.Random(4242)
N = 8192
fib = []; seen = set()
while len(fib) < N:
    L = rng.choice([rng.randint(0,16), rng.randint(17,64), rng.randint(65,128)])
    a = ref.mask(rng.getrandbits(128), L)
    if (a,L) in seen: continue
    seen.add((a,L)); fib.append((a,L,rng.randint(0,4194302)))

puts = [rng.choice(fib) for _ in range(131072 - N)]
allputs = fib + puts
rng.shuffle(allputs)
# live state = last write wins
state = {}
for (a,l,h) in allputs: state[(a,l)] = h
statel = [(a,l,h) for ((a,l),h) in state.items()]
queries = [rng.choice(fib)[0] | (rng.getrandbits(128) & ((1<<(128-ref.mask(0,0) or 0))-1)) if False else rng.getrandbits(128) for _ in range(1000)]
queries += [rng.choice(fib)[0] for _ in range(130072)]

ops = [['put', hx(a), l, h] for (a,l,h) in allputs]
# three saves spread over the puts, plus queries and loads
ops.append(['query', [hx(a) for a in queries[:65536]]])
ops.append(['save'])
ops.append(['load_saved', 0])
ops.append(['image_query', [hx(a) for a in queries[:1000]]])
ops.append(['save'])
ops.append(['save'])
ops.append(['query', [hx(a) for a in queries[65536:]]])
for i in range(13):
    ops.append(['load_saved', i % 3])
req = {'cases': [{'ops': ops}]}
raw = json.dumps(req)
print('request MiB %.1f' % (len(raw)/1048576.0), 'ops', len(ops))
t0 = time.time()
p = __import__('subprocess').run([sys.executable, '/workspace/run.py'], input=raw.encode(),
                                 capture_output=True, cwd='/workspace')
t1 = time.time()
print('elapsed %.1fs rc=%d' % (t1-t0, p.returncode), p.stderr.decode()[:300])
resp = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
print('stdout MiB %.2f' % (len(p.stdout)/1048576.0))
r = resp['results'][0]
exp = [ref.lpm(statel, a) for a in queries[:65536]]
print('live answers ok', r['answers'][:65536] == exp)
exp2 = [ref.lpm(statel, a) for a in queries[65536:]]
print('live answers2 ok', r['answers'][-len(exp2):] == exp2)
print('loads', r['loads'])
print('snapshots', len(r['snapshots']))
for i, img in enumerate(r['snapshots']):
    t2 = time.time(); ok, reason = ref.validate_image(img); t3 = time.time()
    print(' snapshot %d valid=%s %s rows=%d cells=%d (%.1fs py)' % (i, ok, reason, sum(len(b) for b in img['banks']), sum(img['cells']), t3-t2))
imgq = r['answers'][65536:66536]
ok, reason, fib0 = ref.validate_image(r['snapshots'][0], want_fib=True)
print('image_query ok', imgq == [ref.lpm(fib0, a) for a in queries[:1000]])
PYEOF
